```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning=FALSE, message = FALSE, echo=TRUE)
require(dplyr)
require(tidyr)
require(ggplot2)
require(forcats)
require(modelsummary)
require(lubridate)
require(survey)
```

```{r}
bop_panel <- readRDS("~/R Projects/Moldova General/BOP/bop_panel.rds")
```

Variables of interest:
- PoliticalLife_Satisfaction
- WillofPeople
- President_Represented
- Country_Influence

```{r}
bop_panel$year <- year(bop_panel$date)
bop_panel$year.f <- as.factor(bop_panel$year)
bop_panel$wave <- as.factor(bop_panel$wave)
bop_panel$date <- as.Date(bop_panel$date)

# converting to numeric
bop_panel$PoliticalLife_Satisfaction <- as.numeric(bop_panel$PoliticalLife_Satisfaction)
bop_panel$President_Represented <- as.numeric(bop_panel$President_Represented)
bop_panel$Country_Influence <- as.numeric(bop_panel$Country_Influence)
```

```{r}
# Identifiers and demographics
vars_demographics <- c(
  "id", "wave", "date", "Age", "Age.f", "Gender", "Ethnicity",
  "Language_Questionnaire", "Ecology", "Education", "Socioeconomic",
  "Macro_Region", "Weights")
```

```{r}
# removing NA values
bop_panel.me <- bop_panel %>%
  drop_na(all_of(vars_demographics))

bop_panel.PolLife <- bop_panel.me %>%
  drop_na(PoliticalLife_Satisfaction)

bop_panel.PresRep <- bop_panel.me %>%
  drop_na(President_Represented)

bop_panel.CountryInfl <- bop_panel.me %>%
  drop_na(Country_Influence)

bop_panel.WillPeople <- bop_panel.me %>%
  drop_na(WillofPeople)

bop_panel.WillPeople$WillofPeople_Yes <- ifelse(bop_panel.WillPeople$WillofPeople == "Yes", 1, 0)

```

# Longitudinal Analysis
```{r}
# Will of People
bop_panel.WillPeople %>%
  group_by(wave, date, WillofPeople_Yes) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(wave, date) %>%
  mutate(
    total      = sum(n),
    percentage = n / total
  ) %>%
  filter(WillofPeople_Yes == 1) %>%
  mutate(
    se    = sqrt(percentage * (1 - percentage) / total),
    lower = percentage - 1.96 * se,
    upper = percentage + 1.96 * se
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = percentage)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), 
              alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Date",
       y = "Percent")
```
```{r}
bop_panel.PolLife %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(
    PoliticalLife_Satisfaction_mean = mean(PoliticalLife_Satisfaction, na.rm = TRUE),
    PoliticalLife_Satisfaction_sd = sd(PoliticalLife_Satisfaction, na.rm = TRUE),
    PoliticalLife_Satisfaction_n = sum(!is.na(PoliticalLife_Satisfaction)),
    PoliticalLife_Satisfaction_se = PoliticalLife_Satisfaction_sd / sqrt(PoliticalLife_Satisfaction_n),
    PoliticalLife_Satisfaction_lower = PoliticalLife_Satisfaction_mean - 1.96 * PoliticalLife_Satisfaction_se,
    PoliticalLife_Satisfaction_upper = PoliticalLife_Satisfaction_mean + 1.96 * PoliticalLife_Satisfaction_se
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(PoliticalLife_Satisfaction_mean, PoliticalLife_Satisfaction_lower,
             PoliticalLife_Satisfaction_upper),
    names_to = c("PoliticalLife_Satisfaction", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "(PoliticalLife_Satisfaction)_(.*)"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = mean)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), 
              alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_y_reverse(limits = c(1,4)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Date",
       y = "Mean Score")
```

# Regression Analysis

## Will of People
```{r}
# changing reference categories
bop_panel.PolLife$Socioeconomic <- fct_relevel(bop_panel.PolLife$Socioeconomic, "medium")
bop_panel.PolLife$Education <- fct_relevel(bop_panel.PolLife$Education, "medium")

bop_svy.WillPeople <- svydesign(id=~1, weights=~Weights, data=bop_panel.WillPeople)
```

```{r}
summary(svyglm(WillofPeople_Yes~Age, design = bop_svy.WillPeople, family = "quasibinomial"))
summary(svyglm(WillofPeople_Yes~Age.f, design = bop_svy.WillPeople, family = "quasibinomial"))
summary(svyglm(WillofPeople_Yes~Gender, design = bop_svy.WillPeople, family = "quasibinomial"))
summary(svyglm(WillofPeople_Yes~Ethnicity, design = bop_svy.WillPeople, family = "quasibinomial"))
summary(svyglm(WillofPeople_Yes~Language_Questionnaire, design = bop_svy.WillPeople, family = "quasibinomial"))
summary(svyglm(WillofPeople_Yes~Ecology, design = bop_svy.WillPeople, family = "quasibinomial"))
summary(svyglm(WillofPeople_Yes~Education, design = bop_svy.WillPeople, family = "quasibinomial"))
summary(svyglm(WillofPeople_Yes~Socioeconomic, design = bop_svy.WillPeople, family = "quasibinomial"))
summary(svyglm(WillofPeople_Yes~Macro_Region, design = bop_svy.WillPeople, family = "quasibinomial"))
summary(svyglm(WillofPeople_Yes~year, design = bop_svy.WillPeople, family = "quasibinomial"))
```

```{r}
model <- svyglm(WillofPeople_Yes ~ Age.f + Gender + Ethnicity + Language_Questionnaire + Ecology + Macro_Region + factor(year), design = bop_svy.WillPeople, family = "quasibinomial")

exp(cbind(OR = coef(model), confint(model)))
```

## Political Life Satisfaction
```{r}
# changing reference categories
bop_panel.PolLife$Socioeconomic <- fct_relevel(bop_panel.PolLife$Socioeconomic, "medium")
bop_panel.PolLife$Education <- fct_relevel(bop_panel.PolLife$Education, "medium")

bop_svy.PolLife <- svydesign(id=~1, weights=~Weights, data=bop_panel.PolLife)
```

```{r}
summary(svyglm(PoliticalLife_Satisfaction~Age, design = bop_svy.PolLife))
summary(svyglm(PoliticalLife_Satisfaction~Age.f, design = bop_svy.PolLife))
summary(svyglm(PoliticalLife_Satisfaction~Gender, design = bop_svy.PolLife))
summary(svyglm(PoliticalLife_Satisfaction~Ethnicity, design = bop_svy.PolLife))
summary(svyglm(PoliticalLife_Satisfaction~Language_Questionnaire, design = bop_svy.PolLife))
summary(svyglm(PoliticalLife_Satisfaction~Ecology, design = bop_svy.PolLife))
summary(svyglm(PoliticalLife_Satisfaction~Education, design = bop_svy.PolLife))
summary(svyglm(PoliticalLife_Satisfaction~Socioeconomic, design = bop_svy.PolLife))
summary(svyglm(PoliticalLife_Satisfaction~Macro_Region, design = bop_svy.PolLife))
summary(svyglm(PoliticalLife_Satisfaction~factor(year), design = bop_svy.PolLife))
```

```{r}
model2 <- svyglm(PoliticalLife_Satisfaction ~ Age.f + Ethnicity + Language_Questionnaire + Ecology + Education + Socioeconomic + Macro_Region + factor(year), design = bop_svy.PolLife)

summary(model2)
```

# Plots
```{r}
modelplot(model, coef_map = coef_plot_demographics, exponentiate = TRUE) + 
  aes(shape = model) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, color = 'black', alpha = 0.4, linetype = "dashed") +
    scale_x_log10() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  xlab("Odds Ratios and 95% CIs")
```
- Age: older groups significant (+)
- Ethnicity: Romanian (+)
- Language of Questionnaire: Russian (-)

```{r}
modelplot(model2, coef_map = coef_plot_demographics) + 
  aes(shape = model) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = 'black', alpha = 0.4, linetype = "dashed") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  xlab("Coefficients and 95% CIs")
```
- Age: middle groups significant (+)
- Ethnicity: Romanian (-)
- Language of Questionnaire: Russian (+)
- Education: high (-)
- Socioeconomic: high (-)
